body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two detected enemies within 5 units and 2 units of each other.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each target is Distracted and Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Increase the Slow on one hit target to 2.
Each hit target has -1 Composure against the next attack it receives until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Order
rider.html: Spend this Authority when one hit enemy misses an Action before your next turn: you or a willing ally within 3 units may move 2 units afterward.
